pending.recursive-dummy-argument-independence: PENDING positive plan: recursive subroutine descend(n,total) copies dummy n to local before CALL descend(n-1,total), then adds n after return; initial total=-99 is set to 0 first and final exact total 1+2+3 proves each dummy value remains instance-specific.

requirements.title: A completed instance ceases to exist
requirements.definition: An instance ceases to exist on completion of its execution.

pending.instance-completion-finalizes-local-stat: PENDING positive plan: function make() declares a local finalizable object whose final subroutine increments module counter from sentinel -5 to -4 at function completion; caller observes returned value first and final counter after the call.
pending.unsaved-local-not-persisted-control: PENDING positive plan: RECURSIVE SUBROUTINE s(n,out) declares local INTEGER :: k with no initializer, no SAVE, and no DATA; it sets k=n, recurses with CALL s(n-1,out) for n>1, then assigns out(n)=k. Caller preinitializes out=[-1,-2,-3], executes CALL s(3,out), and expects exact [1,2,3], proving each active instance keeps its own unsaved local across inner calls. Companion SUBROUTINE save_count(out) has INTEGER, SAVE :: counter=0, increments it on each of three calls, and records exact [1,2,3], distinguishing shared SAVE state from the unsaved recursive local.
